english_title: Theorem 1.1: Identity Theorem for Continuous Functions
statement_en: Let $f,g:X\to Y$ be continuous maps from a topological space $X$ to a Hausdorff space $Y$. If $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in Z$$ for some dense subset $Z\subset X$, then $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in X.$$
